cutover_sequence: Verify replacement feed is publicly reachable and contains Merchant-valid items.
Add the NEO Spreadshop feed as a new Merchant Center data source.
Wait for Google Merchant Center to ingest and process the replacement source.
Confirm the replacement source is healthy and product diagnostics are acceptable.
Disable or remove the legacy Shopify source only after replacement ingestion is confirmed.
rollback: If the replacement source fails ingestion, re-enable the legacy Shopify source and investigate the NEO feed without leaving Merchant Center empty.
